mathematics.assertion_tested: The six specified rational examples satisfy their displayed matrix, functional, finite-measure, and recurrence identities. The named omitted-bridge, coarse-map, untransported-defect, wrong-basis, lost-correlation, and incomplete-state controls produce the stated different results. All five split positions of the declared four-input filter run preserve the entire output and final state when the full continuation state is carried.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational arithmetic using fractions.Fraction. Metric matrices are interpreted as real positive-definite forms with rational entries. Measures have finite rational atoms and weights.
mathematics.conventions: Column vectors; AB applies B first. Coarse defects are actual observation minus proposed observation. Metric defects are the change in squared norm. B maps falling-basis coefficients to ordinary-power coefficients. The interval measure is dx on [0,1]. Filter state after input n is (x_n,y_n), with zero initial prehistory unless the empty-run control supplies an explicit state.
inputs: Coarse defects: q=[1,1], T=diag(2,3), U=diag(3,2), barT=2, barU=3, x=(1,2); additional U'=diag(3,4) with barU'=3, and independent composite candidate 5.
Metric defects: T=diag(2,1), U=diag(1/2,3), all three metrics I, v=(1,1).
Moment covector: ordered bases (1,x,x^2,x^3) and (1,x,x^2-x,x^3-3x^2+2x); integral on [0,1]; p=x^3 with falling coefficients (0,1,3,1). All four basis moments are checked.
Finite measures: mu=(delta_0+delta_1)/2, phi(t)=1+2t, nu=phi_*mu; p(y)=y^2; product nu tensor nu and correlated gamma=(phi,phi)_*mu evaluated on yz.
Filter: y_n=x_n+(1/2)x_(n-1)+(1/3)y_(n-1), input (2,1,0,0), initial state (0,0); cuts 0 through 4 inclusive; reset and individual-state omissions at cut 2; empty input with a declared supplied state.
non_claims: This run does not replace the written algebraic arguments for varying maps or arbitrary finite input lengths.
This run does not establish infinite-dimensional convergence, numerical stability, or results for arbitrary nonlinear measures and filters.
This run does not replay Lean or certify every claim in the operator catalog or Komorebi Math library.
The six worked recipes are separate from the 164 imported catalog fixtures and do not change that fixture count.
